description: Adjacency and rhythm rules for the three templates. `adjacency` is derived from every consecutive pair in templates/templates.json (extraction check recomputes it). Rules carry a severity; semantic_validate.py implements each rule id listed here and verify_all.py checks the two agree.

rules.text: shell.navbar is the first node on every page and appears once.
shell.footer is the last node, except that shell.youtube-overlay may follow it.
shell.youtube-overlay, when present, is the final node.
Every section type appears at most once per page (no section here repeats).
hero.landing-hero, when present, directly follows shell.navbar.
template.not-found contains no hero, showcase, features, faq or cta nodes.

Every videoId in hero.landing-hero (introVideoId, secondaryCta.videoId) and features.feature-grid (demoVideoId) matches a videos[].id in shell.youtube-overlay, and a page that references any video includes the overlay.
showcase.persona-tabs.initialTab equals one of its tabs[].id.
On a persona route the initialTab equals the template's routeInitialTab value; on / it equals constraints.requiredInitialTab.
navbar.activeLinkHref equals the template's navActiveLinkHref (the landing page marks '/', persona routes and the 404 mark none).
A tab of kind apps carries apps[], a tab of kind logos carries logos[]; the schema enforces it, the validator also checks at most 4 entries.
At most one icon-press-and-burst section per page.
Tab ids and FAQ questions are unique within a page.
